prayer_text: Heavenly Father, thank you for this new day. Give us patience when plans change and courage when someone needs our help. Teach us to listen with care, speak with kindness, and forgive as you forgive us. Remember those who wake with worry or grief, and help us be there for them. In Jesus’ name, amen.
